steps.en: Install the plugin from the Claude Code marketplace
steps.zh: 从 Claude Code 插件市场装上插件

steps.en: Run the audit once to wire the hooks
steps.zh: 跑一次审计，把钩子接好

steps.en: Hooks go live for every session — compression, checkpoints, quality scoring, dashboard
steps.zh: 钩子在每场会话生效——压缩、检查点、质量打分、仪表盘

steps.en: Work as usual — edit files, run tests
steps.zh: 照常干活——改文件、跑测试

steps.en: Re-reads come back as diffs or skeletons, CLI output compressed; raw archived first
steps.zh: 重读只回差异或骨架，CLI 输出被压缩；原始内容先归档

steps.en: At auto-compact: checkpoints the session before, restores what the summary dropped after
steps.zh: auto-compact 时先检查点，过后恢复被摘要丢掉的部分

value.en: Cheaper sessions that keep their thread across compaction — every saving metered in local SQLite
value.zh: 会话更便宜、还熬得过 compaction——每笔节省都记进本地 SQLite

sources: https://github.com/alexgreensh/token-optimizer README Install (/plugin marketplace add alexgreensh/token-optimizer; then /token-optimizer once to set up hooks)
README What You Get + Active Compression (PreToolUse hooks intercept Read/Bash; PostToolUse archives the full original; expand retrieves it)
README Smart Compaction (checkpoints before auto-compact, restores after)
README The Dashboard (auto-regenerates after every session via the SessionEnd hook)
